# arif-fazil.com — Federation Entry Point

> Muhammad Arif bin Fazil. Exploration geoscientist, offshore Malaysia.
> Builder of arifOS — a constitutional AI governance federation.
> **SOT:** 2026-07-24 | **seal_seq:** fed-phase-3

## About This Domain

arif-fazil.com is the human entry point to the arifOS Federation. It links to all 7 federation organs and the sovereign's professional profile.

| Organ | URL | Role |
|-------|-----|------|
| arifOS | https://arifos.arif-fazil.com | Constitutional kernel — judge, seal, F1-F13 |
| AAA | https://aaa.arif-fazil.com | Cockpit + A2A identity layer |
| A-FORGE | https://forge.arif-fazil.com | Execution shell — build, deploy, forge |
| GEOX | https://geox.arif-fazil.com | Earth intelligence — wells, seismic, petrophysics |
| WEALTH | https://wealth.arif-fazil.com | Capital intelligence — NPV, IRR, EMV |
| WELL | https://well.arif-fazil.com | Vitality guard — REFLECT_ONLY |
| HERMES | https://t.me/arifos | Multi-modal bridge — Telegram relay |
